lines.text: 8.2 Area of Paths around a Shape
walking track around the playground, first we find the area of the playground, and then find
the area of the whole space covered by the playground and the walking track. Then
subtract the area of the playground from the whole area covered by the playground and
walking track.
± Area of border = Area of large rectangle - Area of small rectangle

Area of the border = (outer length × outer width) - (inner length × inner width)
Length of large rectangle = Length of small rectangle + 2 × Width of the border
Width of large rectangle = Width of small rectangle + 2 × Width of the border
Example 1:
A rectangle ABCD is 200 cm long and 100 cm wide. There is a border towards the inner side
of the rectangle that is 5 cm wide. Find the area of the border.
Solution:
5cm
100cm
Length of the rectangle = 200 cm
Width of the rectangle = 100 cm
200cm
Area of the rectangle = 200 × 100 = 20000 cm²
Length of the rectangle without border = 200 - 5 - 5 = 200 - 10 = 190 cm
Width of the rectangle without border = 100 - 5 - 5 = 100 - 10 = 90 cm
Area of the rectangle without border = 190 cm × 90 cm = 17100 cm²
Area of the border = 20000 cm² - 17100 cm = 2900 cm²
